nodes.name: Workboard plugin
nodes.summary: Bundled, disabled-by-default Control UI plugin adding a Kanban Cards board and a rule-based Sessions board over Gateway-owned facts.

nodes.name: Canvas plugin
nodes.summary: Plugin that validates/renders A2UI JSONL board widgets and presents hosted widget documents on paired macOS node panels.

nodes.name: Workboard contract package
nodes.summary: Shared @openclaw/workboard-contract enums and types consumed by both the Gateway plugin and the Control UI browser plugin.

nodes.name: Core canvas host (src/canvas)
nodes.summary: Core show_widget tool, canvas document store/serve, widget HTML wrapper and board-widget materialization for streaming widgets into chat.

nodes.name: Gateway board methods
nodes.summary: board.widget.put / canvas.document.* handlers plus board sandbox, view-ticket and view-auth helpers.

nodes.name: Control UI (ui/)
nodes.summary: Lit web app that hosts dashboards, workboard tab and sandboxed widget iframes; wire contract for the macOS native browser bridge.

nodes.name: macOS app (Swift)
nodes.summary: AppKit/WebKit app owning embedded reading tabs, dashboard windows, WebChat windows and native alert/download surfaces.

nodes.name: Workboard board
nodes.summary: A named namespace of agent-owned cards with statuses triage..done, priorities, claims, dispatch and diagnostics.

nodes.name: Sessions board
nodes.summary: Board whose columns are match rules over Gateway run state, observer health and pull-request state; sessions placed by rule then operator pin.

nodes.name: A2UI widget system
nodes.summary: Agent emits declarative JSONL widget messages that are validated (v0.8/v0.9), composed into an HTML document and rendered by openclaw-a2ui-host.

nodes.name: Canvas host / widget host
nodes.summary: Sandboxed iframe/document host that wraps agent-authored widget bytes with a pre-widget message-channel bridge and default-src none CSP.

nodes.name: Dashboard flavors
nodes.summary: Distinguishes Control UI, Workboard, canvas/board widgets and the macOS embedded reading browser as separate surfaces.

nodes.name: Native browser bridge
nodes.summary: Wire contract between the Control UI web page and the macOS WKWebView tab host via webkit.messageHandlers.openclawBrowser.

nodes.name: WebChat window lifecycle
nodes.summary: Manager-owned fleet of Gateway chat/dashboard windows with per-target routing, fallback between Web and Native experiences.

nodes.name: Workboard plugin entry
nodes.summary: definePluginEntry for id workboard: opens the SQLite store, wires change-event/automation/sessions-board/lifecycle services, registers Control UI tab+widget descriptors, RPC, tools, command and CLI.

nodes.name: Workboard RPC methods
nodes.summary: registerWorkboardGatewayMethods registers every workboard.* method under operator.read/operator.write with CAS, workspace authority and claim-token redaction.

nodes.name: Workboard change events
nodes.summary: Service that emits plugin.workboard.changed on every store change and polls reconcileExternalChanges once per second.

nodes.name: Sessions board service
nodes.summary: createWorkboardSessionsBoardService reads/updates/moves the sessions board, fusing run state, observer digests and PR facts into placements.

nodes.name: Workboard SQLite store
nodes.summary: WorkboardStore holds cards, boards, events, attempts, comments, links, proof, artifacts, attachments, diagnostics and notifications in a plugin-owned relational DB.

nodes.name: Workboard dispatcher
nodes.summary: Promotes dependency-ready cards, blocks expired claims and starts Gateway subagent worker runs for a bounded batch of ready cards.

nodes.name: Workboard lifecycle sync
nodes.summary: Keeps card status in sync with linked session lifecycle; persists terminal outcomes on agent/subagent end and sweeps once per minute.

nodes.name: Workboard card tools
nodes.summary: createWorkboardTools exposes the workboard_* card tools to agents, gated by workspace access.

nodes.name: Sessions board tools
nodes.summary: createWorkboardSessionsBoardTools exposes workboard_sessions_board_read/update/move to the docked Board agent without a tools.allow entry.

nodes.name: Workboard Control UI plugin
nodes.summary: defineControlUiPlugin activate: registers page, navigation per board, session accessory and mini/card/board widgets; subscribes to invalidations and plugin.workboard.changed.

nodes.name: Workboard browser host
nodes.summary: Holds the active ControlUiHost and redaction function for the browser plugin; throws when the plugin is no longer active.

nodes.name: Workboard widgets
nodes.summary: createWorkboardWidget mounts mini/card/board widgets with lit, leasing a shared widget runtime only while presented and honoring write access.

nodes.name: WorkboardCatalog
nodes.summary: Loads the board catalog on connect and on change events, retrying after 2s, and publishes a catalog snapshot to navigation.

nodes.name: Delete board dialog
nodes.summary: Confirmation dialog that calls workboard.boards.delete and handles abort/unavailable/write-scope states.

nodes.name: Workboard live refresh
nodes.summary: Coalesces plugin.workboard.changed into at most one pending canonical reload, deferring during drags/writes and while the document is hidden.

nodes.name: Workboard UI state types
nodes.summary: Re-exports the contract and defines WorkboardUiState, WorkboardLifecycle and dispatch-summary types for the browser plugin.

nodes.name: Workboard capability
nodes.summary: Shared browser capability object with state/boardsReady/notify/subscribe and catalog clearing used by page, widgets and accessory.

nodes.name: Workboard contract index
nodes.summary: Enums (statuses/priorities/events/diagnostics), WORKBOARD_CHANGED_EVENT, WorkboardChange, board metadata/summary and card shape types.

nodes.name: Sessions board contract
nodes.summary: WorkboardSessionsBoardSpec/Read types, observer-health/run/PR unions and createDefaultWorkboardSessionsBoardSpec with the six default columns.

nodes.name: Canvas plugin entry
nodes.summary: Registers the A2UI board widget content kind, A2UI HTTP route, node-panel widget presenter, node.invoke policy and the canvas agent tool.

nodes.name: Canvas agent tool
nodes.summary: createCanvasTool resolves an eligible node and invokes canvas.present/hide/navigate via node.invoke with transport timeout grace.

nodes.name: Canvas tool schema
nodes.summary: Typebox schema for the canvas tool: action present|hide|navigate, node selector, placement and url/gateway params.

nodes.name: Canvas widget presenter
nodes.summary: createCanvasWidgetPresenter targets node_panel, selects an eligible canvas-capable node and invokes canvas.present with the hosted document URL.

nodes.name: A2UI board widget kind
nodes.summary: canvasA2UIBoardWidgetKind declares kind a2ui, bundle resources, validateSource and composeDocument producing boot script + openclaw-a2ui-host.

nodes.name: A2UI JSONL validator
nodes.summary: validateSupportedA2UIJsonl parses one-action-per-line JSONL, enforces v0.8 (unversioned) vs v0.9 (schema-validated) and rejects mixed files.

nodes.name: Canvas plugin config
nodes.summary: Parses canvas.host config and decides host enablement, honoring the OPENCLAW_SKIP_CANVAS_HOST env override.

nodes.name: A2UI host resolver
nodes.summary: Resolves the on-disk A2UI root across candidate dirs with a 10s null-retry cache and serves requests via the shared route handler.

nodes.name: A2UI HTTP route
nodes.summary: handleA2uiHttpRequestWithRootResolver serves A2UI assets GET/HEAD with no-store caching and the given root resolver.

nodes.name: A2UI path constants
nodes.summary: Defines A2UI_PATH, CANVAS_HOST_PATH and isA2uiPath for the canvas host routes.

nodes.name: Canvas node eligibility
nodes.summary: Selects canvas-capable nodes and defines CANVAS_PRESENT_COMMAND used by the tool and presenter.

nodes.name: show_widget tool
nodes.summary: createShowWidgetTool validates widget code/report/kind, pins through board.widget.put or hosts a canvas document and returns inline/canvas/pinned results.

nodes.name: Canvas document store
nodes.summary: createCanvasDocument writes index.html + manifest.json under the canvas documents root, normalizing ids/paths and pruning per-scope documents.

nodes.name: Canvas document server
nodes.summary: handleCanvasDocumentHttpRequest serves canvas documents from the fs-safe root, adding a CSP sandbox header for script-enabled HTML.

nodes.name: Widget HTML wrapper
nodes.summary: buildWidgetDocument wraps widget code in a full HTML document with bridge bootstrap, default-src none CSP, size reporter and theme bridge.

nodes.name: Canvas host constants
nodes.summary: CANVAS_DOCUMENTS_PATH, the core canvas node capability and helpers to add it while removing stale plugin duplicates.

nodes.name: Widget script syntax check
nodes.summary: findWidgetScriptSyntaxError flags invalid inline widget scripts before hosting.

nodes.name: Board gateway method
nodes.summary: board.widget.put materializes html/canvas-doc/mcp-app/registered content, wraps HTML with buildWidgetDocument and stores the widget on the board.

nodes.name: Canvas gateway methods
nodes.summary: canvas.document.view/preview return html + sandbox url/port/origin from the shared isolated sandbox host with caller assertions.

nodes.name: Board widget sandbox
nodes.summary: buildBoardWidgetSandboxPath + buildBoardWidgetContentSecurityPolicy produce the sandbox host path and default-src none / sandbox allow-scripts CSP.

nodes.name: Board widget view auth
nodes.summary: withAuthorizedBoardWidgetView verifies a view ticket and re-composes registered content for a widget view.

nodes.name: Board view tickets
nodes.summary: create/verify board view tickets with a 20-minute TTL bound to sessionKey/agentId/name/revision/viewGeneration and frame URLs.

nodes.name: BoardWidgetSandboxHost
nodes.summary: Owns one trusted outer sandbox frame and its ticket-bound inner widget bridge, forwarding board.event/prompt/data/canvas bridge messages.

nodes.name: BoardWidgetBridgeController
nodes.summary: Validates openclaw:widget-bridge-request messages and proxies board.event, board.prompt.authorize and data.read/action to the Gateway.

nodes.name: BoardWidgetFrame
nodes.summary: Lit element that hosts a board widget iframe, resolving the sandbox URL, refreshing tickets before expiry and reporting size/scroll.

nodes.name: Native browser bridge (UI)
nodes.summary: Typed Control UI client for openclawBrowser: validates outgoing messages, posts via webkit.messageHandlers and reads/pushes native browser state.

nodes.name: DashboardsPage
nodes.summary: Lit page element that loads route data and renders the dashboard gallery and board views.

nodes.name: Dashboards view
nodes.summary: renderDashboards renders the dashboard gallery with filters and handlers.

nodes.name: DashboardBrowserTab
nodes.summary: A WKWebView reading tab with its own website data store and a navigation-identity alias for redirect-safe link reuse.

nodes.name: DashboardNativeBrowserHost
nodes.summary: Owns tabs, download map and per-scope presentations, pushing debounced DashboardBrowserState to the Control UI.

nodes.name: DashboardBrowserMessageHandler
nodes.summary: WKScriptMessageHandlerWithReply named openclawBrowser that decodes open/navigate/present/inspect/action requests with strict validation.

nodes.name: DashboardBrowserDownload
nodes.summary: WKDownloadDelegate that stages downloads in an item-replacement dir and commits only on success via an NSSavePanel.

nodes.name: DashboardBrowserSessionStore
nodes.summary: Per-saved-Gateway WKWebsiteDataStore with revision-gated leases that validate sessions before preparing controllers and publishing cookies.

nodes.name: DashboardAlertPresenter
nodes.summary: Presents NSAlerts as window sheets or floating NSPanels, coalescing identical informational alerts without a nested modal loop.

nodes.name: DashboardWebView
nodes.summary: WKWebView subclass that filters native-browser context menu items such as open-in-new-window and download.

nodes.name: DashboardWindowController native browser
nodes.summary: Extension that validates and dispatches openclawBrowser messages to the native browser host and publishes browser state to the web page.

nodes.name: WebChatManager
nodes.summary: Owns the fleet of Gateway chat/dashboard windows, routing and key/front-window state, closing windows on profile changes.

nodes.name: WebChatRoute
nodes.summary: Struct mapping a session key + agent id to a Control UI dashboard path or draft fragment, encoding dot/key segments.

nodes.name: WebChatSwiftUI
nodes.summary: SwiftUI native chat surface used by Quick Chat and the Native experience fallback, talking to the Gateway WebSocket.

nodes.name: Workboard plugin doc
nodes.summary: Documents the Workboard plugin: cards, Sessions board rules, widgets, RPC scopes, storage and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: Workboard CLI doc
nodes.summary: Documents openclaw workboard list/create/show/move/dispatch, id prefixes, dispatch selection and Gateway fallback.

nodes.name: WebChat doc
nodes.summary: Documents the WebChat RPC/event data plane, history normalization, mentions and delivery model.

nodes.name: WebChat macOS doc
nodes.summary: Documents the macOS Web vs Native experience, native chat window, Quick Chat and Gateway window management.

nodes.name: registerWorkboardGatewayMethods
nodes.summary: Registers all workboard.* RPC methods with read/write scopes and store-operation wrapping.

nodes.name: createWorkboardChangeEventService
nodes.summary: Builds the service that subscribes store changes, emits plugin.workboard.changed and polls external changes.

nodes.name: createWorkboardSessionsBoardService
nodes.summary: Builds the sessions-board service exposing read/update/move over fused session facts.

nodes.name: createWorkboardTools
nodes.summary: Creates the workboard_* card agent tools scoped to a plugin context.

nodes.name: createWorkboardSessionsBoardTools
nodes.summary: Creates the sessions-board agent tools used by the docked Board agent.

nodes.name: dispatchAndStartWorkboardCards
nodes.summary: Promotes, blocks and starts a bounded batch of ready cards as Gateway subagent worker runs.

nodes.name: WorkboardCatalog
nodes.summary: Class that loads and republishes the board catalog with generation guards and retry.

nodes.name: createWorkboardWidget
nodes.summary: Returns a mount function for a mini/card/board workboard widget using lit render.

nodes.name: handleWorkboardChanged
nodes.summary: Normalizes a change payload, updates epoch/revision and schedules a coalesced canonical reload.

nodes.name: createDefaultWorkboardSessionsBoardSpec
nodes.summary: Returns the default six-column sessions board spec (needs-input/stuck/working/in-review/merged/done).

nodes.name: createCanvasTool
nodes.summary: Builds the lazy canvas agent tool that invokes node canvas commands.

nodes.name: createCanvasWidgetPresenter
nodes.summary: Builds the node_panel widget presenter that selects an eligible node and invokes canvas.present.

nodes.name: validateSupportedA2UIJsonl
nodes.summary: Validates A2UI JSONL and returns version, messageCount and parsed messages.

nodes.name: handleA2uiHttpRequest
nodes.summary: Serves A2UI assets resolved through the cached realpath root.

nodes.name: createShowWidgetTool
nodes.summary: Builds the show_widget tool that pins or hosts agent-authored widgets.

nodes.name: createCanvasDocument
nodes.summary: Creates a canvas document directory + manifest and returns its manifest/entryUrl.

nodes.name: handleCanvasDocumentHttpRequest
nodes.summary: Serves canvas documents from the fs-safe root with optional CSP sandbox header.

nodes.name: buildWidgetDocument
nodes.summary: Composes the widget HTML document with bridge bootstrap and CSP.

nodes.name: buildBoardWidgetSandboxPath
nodes.summary: Builds the sandbox host path from granted connect/media/resource domains.

nodes.name: withAuthorizedBoardWidgetView
nodes.summary: Verifies a widget view ticket and re-composes registered content under authority.

nodes.name: BoardWidgetSandboxHost
nodes.summary: Owns the outer sandbox frame and inner ticket-bound widget bridge.

nodes.name: BoardWidgetBridgeController
nodes.summary: Handles widget bridge requests and proxies them to Gateway methods.

nodes.name: DashboardsPage
nodes.summary: Lit page element owning dashboard gallery filters and rendering.

nodes.name: DashboardBrowserTab
nodes.summary: MainActor class wrapping one WKWebView reading tab and its navigation state.

nodes.name: DashboardNativeBrowserHost
nodes.summary: MainActor host of tabs, downloads and presentations.

nodes.name: DashboardBrowserMessageHandler
nodes.summary: Script message handler with reply for the native browser bridge.

nodes.name: DashboardBrowserDownload
nodes.summary: WKDownloadDelegate for one user-requested transfer.

nodes.name: DashboardBrowserSessionStore
nodes.summary: Per-profile WebKit data store with revision-gated leases.

nodes.name: DashboardAlertPresenter
nodes.summary: MainActor alert presenter with sheet/panel fallback and coalescing.

nodes.name: WebChatManager
nodes.summary: Manages the fleet of Gateway chat/dashboard windows and their routing.

nodes.name: WebChatRoute
nodes.summary: Value type mapping session keys to Control UI dashboard paths.

nodes.name: board.widget.put
nodes.summary: Gateway write method that materializes and stores a pinned board widget.

nodes.name: canvas.document.view
nodes.summary: Gateway read method returning a canvas document's html + sandbox host info.

nodes.name: canvas.document.preview
nodes.summary: Gateway method hosting a caller-provided HTML preview inside the isolated sandbox.

nodes.name: workboard.cards.list
nodes.summary: operator.read method listing cards with revision-freshness shortcut.

nodes.name: workboard.cards.update
nodes.summary: operator.write method updating a card with optional expectedUpdatedAt CAS.

nodes.name: workboard.cards.move
nodes.summary: operator.write method moving a card status/position with CAS.

nodes.name: workboard.boards.upsert
nodes.summary: operator.write method creating/updating a board spec.

nodes.name: workboard.boards.delete
nodes.summary: operator.write method deleting a board.

nodes.name: workboard.sessionsBoard.read
nodes.summary: operator.read method returning fused sessions board facts/placements with revision.

nodes.name: workboard.cards.dispatch
nodes.summary: operator.write method starting a dispatch pass that launches subagent workers.

nodes.name: workboard.notifications.events
nodes.summary: operator.read method returning notification events without cursor advance.

nodes.name: board.event
nodes.summary: Gateway method the widget bridge calls to forward widget-originated events.

edges.description: gatewayCall board.widget.put to pin a widget
document served through the isolated sandbox host
shared navigation/ui delegates passed to tabs
tabs share the session store's WKWebsiteDataStore
maps sessions to Control UI dashboard paths
publishes DashboardBrowserState to the dashboard page
